official_definition: Friendshipower - (When Attacks) For each two "Idol" family Spirits you control, add an extra Yellow symbol to this Spirit. Also, if you control a "Minato Mio", discard the opposing Burst.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Friendshipower] or [Friendshipower: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Friendshipower]", "give [Friendshipower]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
